scenes: Delhi. Fierce heat before the monsoon, street trade, and falling groundwater.
In heatwaves, eight in ten Delhi street vendors surveyed saw fewer customers.
Its 2025 heat plan brought alerts, cooling shelters, and three thousand water points.
Steady funds can help it last beyond each summer.
